# 320 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m320_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m320_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 320 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m320_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m320_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m320_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m320_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m320_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m320_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m320_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m320_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m320_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m320_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m320_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m320_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m320_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m320_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m320_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 320 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m320_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 320 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_aggregate_audit_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m320_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m320_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m320_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 320 exit_signal obligation"
    }
}

            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_manager_reserved value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_manager_settled value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_manager_status value = 0 }
            zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_reserved
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_status
                    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_owner
                    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_cycle
                    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_case
                    AMOUNT = 2
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_status
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:zg361_cl_m321_treasury_status = 2
                var:zg361_cl_m321_manager_status = 2
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            # No business receipt exists yet.  Undo either shadow journal so
            # a later retry sees a clean dual-payer transaction.
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m321_treasury_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m321_treasury_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_status
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m321_manager_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m321_manager_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_status
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
    }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m321_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 321
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_deferred value = 0 }
                if = {
                limit = { OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                } }
                var:zg361_case_ah_owner = {
                    remove_treasury = 4
                    add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 2 }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_total_cost value = 6 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_share value = 4 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_manager_share value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_dual_payment_settled value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_total_cost value = 0 }
            }
                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_kind_id value = 10 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_relationship_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m321_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_alumnus value = var:zg361_cl_m321_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_days value = 365 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.821 days = 365 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.821 days = 30 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m321_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {
                # The shadow journals settled before the business receipt.  If the
                # receipt unexpectedly loses its frozen guard, undo both journals;
                # no CK3 gold has been deducted yet and the same ticket may retry.
                if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m321_treasury_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m321_treasury_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_treasury_status
                }
            }
                if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:zg361_cl_m321_manager_status = 1
                        var:zg361_cl_m321_manager_status = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_refund_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ah_revision
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                    TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                    TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                    TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                    TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                    AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_available
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_manager_status
                }
            }
                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 321 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 321 } }
    }
}

# 321 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m321_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ah_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ah_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 5
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m321_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m321_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_consent value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_maintenance_once_per_cycle value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_lead_idempotent value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_contact_projection_deleted value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_humiliation_history_immutable value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_talent_reputation_delta value = 2 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m321_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_consent value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_contact_projection_deleted value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_talent_reputation_delta value = -10 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m321_talent_reputation_delta }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m321_route = 1 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m321_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m321_route = 2 }
            add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m321_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_relationship_revision value = 1 }
        }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 321 market.maintain_alumni_relationship"
    }
}

# 321 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m321_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m321_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 321 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m321_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m321_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m321_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m321_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m321_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m321_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m321_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m321_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m321_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m321_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m321_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m321_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m321_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m321_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m321_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 321 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m321_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 321 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_alumni_contact_cycle_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m321_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_debt_overdue value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m321_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m321_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = angry_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m321_object_owner opinion = -5 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }
                add_opinion = { modifier = friendliness_opinion target = var:zg361_cl_m321_object_owner opinion = 5 }
            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 321 alumni_relation obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m321_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m321_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# Assessed count/baron self-response.  It grants no manager or case authority.
zg361_cl_m321_subject_response_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_cl_subject_response_applied
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ah_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ah_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ah_active
            }
            NOT = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m321_subject_response }
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_cl_subject_route = 2
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m321_subject_response value = scope:zg361_cl_subject_route }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_subject_response_applied value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_ah_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: assessed subject answered 321 once"
    }
}
